assessment_goal: Identify the correct property or method used to access the immediate child nodes of a specific DOM element.
misconception_target: Confusing the 'children' collection (element nodes only) with 'childNodes' (which includes text and comment nodes).

assessment_goal: Recall the specific property used to navigate from a node to its parent node in the DOM hierarchy.
misconception_target: Using 'parent' instead of the standard 'parentNode' or 'parentElement' property names.

assessment_goal: Distinguish between methods that traverse siblings (next/previous) and methods that traverse descendants (querySelectorAll).
misconception_target: Assuming that 'nextSibling' always returns the next element node, ignoring that it may return a text node.

assessment_goal: Identify the standard HTML5 attribute used to enforce that a form field must not be empty before submission.
misconception_target: Confusing the 'required' attribute with 'validate' or 'mandatory', which are not standard HTML5 validation attributes.

assessment_goal: Recall the specific JavaScript property on an input element that indicates whether the current value satisfies the validation constraints.
misconception_target: Using 'isValid' or 'checkValidity' as a boolean property instead of the 'validity' object or the 'checkValidity()' method.
